notes.title: SCIENCE! GRAPHICAL UPDATES WOO PLAYERS!
notes.content:
Thanks to all our early adopters and their continuing feedback! We've put some spit and polish on some of the graphical elements as we continue to build out the game,



[h3]BUILDING OVERHAUL[/h3]

One of the complaints we got was the environment being too "flat". Considering the game is played on a flat screen, we took this to be "accurate". But instead of taking things too literally we dug deep into our two dimensional souls and made some updates to the buildings across the many generated cityscapes of GORILLA TOWN. We've redrawn the sprites to have more depth and shadow, as well as allowed the escaping citizens to leave a few lights on before they left. A comparison:

Old terrible no-good flat buildings with dark windows:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36511139/2ff1704c44de359b7dca311dae8297e11f8c46f3.png[/img]

Ever so slightly improved buildings with lit windows (also showing the new film grain, and HUD, and larger characters, etc)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36511139/ffb800c05641392abb0c69bd45a86f8d29af77aa.png[/img]

Along with buildings we also adjusted the look of the stone cliffs in the later levels and multiplayer levels. Instead of procedurally generating the stone faces present on the cliffs, we took a more straightforward approach and use pre-made sprites. This makes these levels generate faster as well as have smoother frame rates overall. This can mean the difference between life and after-life when fighting the cranky Panzeraffe robot. 

BONUS! We also made it so the  cliffs can be generated in different colors to add more variety as well.


Before:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36511139/7914872df1375a6eb150230f278dea73c5bc0618.png[/img]

After:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36511139/2f280898e98f560b76b22d965fcb86d3885f884f.png[/img]

[h3]Sharper Characters[/h3]
Victor the Gorilla and his robotic enemies are now 200% sharper with higher resolution textures. This really shows in the [i]Robot Lexicon[/i] that is shown before jumping in to a level in single player, as well as the multiplayer character selection screen:

Before:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36511139/5e050727794acf6aa998fc493acc2a2832add16d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36511139/99f096d1ae943502503fa04476b1177bcc98228c.png[/img]

After:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36511139/28cd6f8b13d794a1556f7e4eaf3e238e3e29cafb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36511139/edd760872538f69bf3a806a3af5ba35db896cd87.png[/img]

[h3]OTHER GOODIES[/h3]



[list]
[*] Stone cliff arrangements in multiplayer are now more random for more interesting combat. Same goes with city levels. SCIENCE!

[*] Added sound effects when hitting robots. We dropped our kitchen utensils and car keys into metal mixing bowls and recorded the outcome for your listening pleasure.

[*] We have changed the film noise effect to be a bit more realistic and less harsh, which makes for more calming and authentic 1920s video game experience (we don't even know what that means). This has been updating in all our Steam screenshots as well.

[/list]

[h3]WHERE IS MY ONLINE MULTIPLAYER!?[/h3]

We didn't forget, and we are toiling away in the code mines so you can battle your friends through the electronic ether. We are currently working on the user interface to make hosting your own server, or joining one, as easy as possible. When we get further along we will post screenshots.

Thanks again to our Early Access players - and we encourage you all to reach out to us with any questions and suggestions!

notes.title: SCIENCE! BETA TESTERS SQUASH VICIOUS BUGS
notes.content:
A huge thank you to all our beta testers - we want to make GORILLA TOWN a fun and bug free experience, and we couldn't do it without you! We've taken all your input from the open beta and implemented a number of improvements:

[h3]HIGHLIGHTS [/h3]
[list]
[*] We've added 15 new radio announcer / voice over quips and also decreased how often you will hear repeats. SCIENCE!

[*] Added multiple flying B.O.X.M.A.N robots to the first three levels for more frenetic action. Our research has concluded that getting to destroy more robots leads to more happiness. SCIENCE!.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36511139/c51c150393aa7550ea3ceeab76a81ed3650d8d15.png[/img]
[/list]

[h3]CONTROL IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Redesigned the player input area at the bottom of the screen so you can see more of the action. SCIENCE!

[*] Got rid of the leftover on-screen control mechanisms. The game evolved into being more challenging where using the mouse to manipulate the on-screen controls would put the player at a major disadvantage. We found that players were attempting to use these on-screen controls and getting their butts kicked way too often. SCIENCE!

[*] Using the mouse to aim and throw bananas has become easier - we change mouse cursors when you hover over Victor the Gorilla as well as when you click and drag to throw. You also don't need to drag the mouse as far to increase your throw power. SCIENCE!

[*] We now support WASD keys for aiming in addition to our original arrow keys. SCIENCE!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36511139/446962f06af0acbc94c8d17873cefa5579edba8f.png[/img]

[*] Get in a sticky situation where you have to toss bananas behind your head? No more! Instead, you can now just flip Victor in the opposite direction using either shift key on the keyboard or the left trigger on your gamepad. SCIENCE!
 [/list]

[h3]OTHER GOODIES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Boss walking by your desk and you frantically minimize the game? We'll pause it for you automatically. SCIENCE?

[*] Sometimes the incepti-tron power up made buildings move too far down the screen causing difficulties while playing, we fixed that! Buildings will stay in a safe zone when being moved so they never go too high or too low where it can become frustrating. SCIENCE!

[*] Improved the overview map usability by fixing the hover elements, SCIENCE!

[/list]


Thanks again to our beta testers! 

Interested in helping out? Hit us up at gorilla.town.game@gmail.com and we'll hook you up with a free copy.
